name: inclusive_tax_half_baisa_midpoint_law
description: LAUNCH-P4 C1: the deterministic midpoint law on the inclusive path. Gross G 1.111 with two 5% taxes, R = 10: each line is 1111 x 5 / 110 = 50.5 EXACTLY, which rounds half AWAY from zero to 51 (round-half-even would give 50). Tax total 51 + 51 = 102 (sum-then-round: 1111 x 10 / 110 = 101). The quotient is computed exactly: rates are scaled to integer ten-thousandths of a percent and divided with integer arithmetic, never on a binary double. Grand = G = 1.111.
